objective: Complete handover for secondary model evaluation: Modernization of Publisher Architecture (Phases 1-4), system stability validation, and production deployment readiness.
executive_summary: All 4 phases of publisher-architecture-modernization-v1 are complete, shipped, and rigorously validated with 278 passing tests across unit, integration, mcp, and competitor intel suites. The implementation completely eliminates the 1-post/hr rate limit retry storm (5-minute spin loop), handles platform maintenance (HTTP 503 / '점검 중입니다') via auto-pausing datetime regex, eliminates 10 dead scripts (~55KB), consolidates state into an authoritative reactive store, retires the legacy bot.ts adapter, and hardens deployment scripts with 100755 permissions.

evaluation_guide_for_second_model.role: Independent Senior Software & Reliability Architect Reviewer
evaluation_guide_for_second_model.evaluation_mandate: Evaluate the correctness, test coverage, architectural hygiene, failure-mode mitigation, and operational readiness of the publisher modernization initiative.

key_review_vectors.vector: 1. Rate-Limit & Cooldown Gating (Elimination of 5-min Retry Storm)
invariants_to_verify: Pre-flight check in `publisherRun.ts` (L178-L218) inspects `publisherHistory` and skips Chromium launch when elapsed time < 60 minutes.
`runPublisherFlow.ts` hooks `page.once('dialog')` before `click-write` to capture alert text, aborting before `open-saved-drafts` if rate-limited.
`detectRateLimit` in `rateLimit.ts` accurately extracts remaining minutes from text or dialog.
`scheduler/run.ts` schedules the next tick for `cooldownRemainingMinutes + 1` on `rate_limited`, completely replacing the old hardcoded 5-minute loop (`PUBLISHER_FAIL_RECHECK_INTERVAL = 5`).
`boardDiagnostics.ts` detects HTTP 502/503/504 and regex matches Korean datetime ranges (e.g., '2026-08-18 02:00 ~ 06:00', '새벽 2시 ~ 6시') with +5m buffer.
`observerRun.ts` treats 503 maintenance as a structured diagnostic (`PLATFORM_MAINTENANCE`) rather than crashing with `BOARD_ACCESS_DENIED`.
`scheduler/run.ts` schedules the next tick directly to the maintenance end time and preserves zero `consecutiveFailures` (no panic alerts on Slack).
`RuntimeStateStore` acts as the single in-memory source of truth with deterministic `stateVersion` increments.
Enforces optimistic locking (`expectedVersion`) throwing `StateVersionConflictError` on stale updates.
Debounces disk persistence to `runtime-controls.json` to prevent I/O thrashing.
Subscribers receive synchronous updates on patch.

key_review_vectors.vector: 4. Modularity, Script Hygiene & Elimination of bot.ts
invariants_to_verify: Legacy monolithic `bot.ts` is deleted with zero references remaining in the codebase.

Micro-files (`timeouts.ts`, `loadPublisherPlaybook.ts`, `stateTransitions.ts`, `ui/submit.ts`) were cleanly consolidated into `runPublisherFlow.ts` while keeping it at 269 lines (well under 500-line budget).
`npm run lint:structure` passes with 0 errors and ratchet baseline reduced from 50 to 42.
All deployment and systemd scripts have executable permissions in git (`100755`).
V8 heap capped at `--max-old-space-size=400` with cgroup limits (`MemoryHigh=450M`, `MemoryMax=500M`) for 512MB VPS protection.
`config/env.ts` and `load-env-from-ssm.sh` fail closed on missing required credentials.
